agent_notes: Normal TLS verification first returned the exact managed-proxy self-signed-certificate-chain error; public GET requests were then retried with curl --insecure after confirming the expected Google and hte.rajasthan.gov.in hostnames.
The official site identifies the campus at Dungar College, Sagar Road, Bikaner, Rajasthan 334001.

The homepage provides current programme cards and the UG admissions page lists current 2026-27 BBA and BCA admissions. The Academic > Course page separately lists graduate/postgraduate subjects plus M.Phil. and Ph.D. subject facilities, but it is prose-based, uses unexplained abbreviations such as E.A.F.M. and BM, and does not provide a single complete structured catalogue with duration and eligibility. Therefore the official catalogue is partial and the record requires manual review.
